column3: MT 142:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “I seek favor” is rendered “I make supplication.”
Close to the Hebrew; “When my spirit faints” is rendered “When my spirit was overwhelmed,” and the present “you know” as past “You knew.”
Close to the Hebrew; “One who recognizes me” is rendered “no one who regards me,” and “a place of escape has perished from me” as “There is no escape for me.”
Close to the Hebrew; The present “I cry … I say” is rendered as past, and NASB marks verses 5–7 as quoted speech.
Close to the Hebrew; “In me the righteous will surround” is rendered “The righteous will surround me,” and “you deal” as “You will deal.”
